early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
rules_primary: If the upper bound of the target range for the federal funds rate in effect at 11:59 PM ET on December 31, 2032, as published on the Federal Reserve’s official website, is above 3.75%, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: If the Federal Reserve specifies a single target rate rather than a target range, that target rate will be used.
title: Will the upper bound of the target range for the federal funds rate in effect at 11:59 PM ET on December 31, 2032 be above 3.75%?
